WIDE: drone-overhead establishing shot from 60-degree angle, the entire real-world environment visible (full kitchen counter / full bookshelf / full park bench), figures small in lower third — environment dominates frame
WIDE: low ground-level wide-angle 24mm, real-world horizon line visible, figures in middle distance with foreground real-world textures (grass blades, dust, gravel) leading into them
WIDE: high-angle 75-degrees-down deep-focus, multiple characters visible across the scene at toy-scale, real environment fills entire frame edge-to-edge
WIDE: forced-perspective wide shot — figures tiny in foreground with massive real-world reference object behind (towering coffee mug, building-sized sneaker, mountain-scale pillow)
WIDE: cinematic 2.39:1 widescreen letterbox, anamorphic lens — figures spread across the panorama in real-environment landscape
WIDE: side-elevation profile shot, real-world setting reads like architectural drawing, multiple figures interacting at clear positions
WIDE: through-the-foliage / through-arch composition — peering into the toy-scale moment from outside the frame, real-world frame elements (grass, doorway, window-glass) surrounding the action
WIDE: dramatic horizon-tilt landscape, figures small and dwarfed by real-world environment (real desert, real ocean, real forest), scale-illusion as entire concept
MEDIUM: 35mm cinematic medium-shot, multiple figures (2-4) in clear narrative positions, real-environment context visible behind, deep focus
MEDIUM: dolly-in tracking shot, figures interacting in middle distance, real-world setting framing them, motion-blur on background
MEDIUM: dutch-angle 15-degree tilt — multiple figures in dynamic mid-action, real-world surface as ground, composition off-balance
MEDIUM: rule-of-thirds composition, lead figure on power-point, supporting figures on opposite power-point, real-world environment in negative space between
MEDIUM: over-the-shoulder reverse-angle — back of one figure framing-left, opposing figure facing camera framing-right, real-world setting receding to depth
MEDIUM: leading-lines composition (real road / real bookshelf-edge / real fence) drawing eye through multiple figures positioned along its length
MEDIUM: silhouette / backlit composition — figures dark against bright real-world backlight (window, sunset, lamp), multiple figures' outlines reading clearly
MEDIUM: from-above tabletop shot — two or more figures in small but readable positions, real-world surface (table, floor, sand) dominating, scattered real-world props between them
MEDIUM: vehicle-cabin POV reversed — looking back through windshield from inside a real-world object (cup, jar, toy car) at multiple figures in approach
CLOSE: hero figure mid-action, secondary figures partially in frame edges (one approaching, one reacting), real-world prop in foreground anchoring scale
CLOSE: macro 100mm with shallow DOF, focal figure tack-sharp, secondary figures soft-bokeh in plate behind, real-world surface texture filling foreground
CLOSE: low-hero up-shot — primary figure looking up at supporting cast, real-world ceiling / sky / overhang towering above, scale-illusion lens
CLOSE: profile pair-frame — two figures in conversation or confrontation, real-world setting depth-of-field bokeh behind both
CLOSE: action freeze-frame — single figure in mid-motion (jump / swing / fall), splash / dust / debris from real-world particles, secondary figure mid-react
CLOSE: through-real-world-object frame — peering at figures through a real keyhole / glass / mesh / leaves, voyeur composition
ATMOSPHERIC: scale-illusion landscape — real-world environment shot with tiny figures barely visible, like the world is the subject and the toys are the surprise reveal
ATMOSPHERIC: forced-perspective extreme — figure's relative scale completely absurd against real-world reference (figure standing on coin = size of dinner plate), making viewers stop scrolling
ATMOSPHERIC: real-world weather drama — fog / rain / snow / sunbeam-shaft as primary subject, figures small but present in environment
ATMOSPHERIC: golden-hour or blue-hour environment shot, real-world setting at peak cinematic light, figures composed as small but story-implying elements
ATMOSPHERIC: vertical-civilization wide — real-world structure (bookshelf / staircase / wall-vines) showing multiple figures across multiple tiers, overall composition reads as map
ATMOSPHERIC: nostalgic found-scene — figures partly buried, weathered, abandoned in real-world setting, lonely emotional tone, environment dominant
ATMOSPHERIC: vehicle-track motion shot — toy vehicle blasting through real-world environment with motion blur, environmental sweep dominant, figures inside cabins barely visible
